description: This shell script performs diagnostic checks for ath10k driver crashes on OpenWrt systems, collecting system logs and crash reports, and guiding users on bug reporting procedures.

methods.name: bugcheck_generic
methods.description: Collects system information like uname, os-release, kernel logs, CPU info, and memory info, and writes it to a report file.

methods.name: roll_crashes
methods.description: Manages rotating crash logs by archiving old crash directories and creating fresh ones.
